terms.title: Agent
terms.description: An LLM-driven reviewer produced the result.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A rule-based analyzer or scanner produced the result without model inference.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A person recorded the result directly.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: The result was migrated from a legacy contract and its original producer may be incomplete.

terms.title: Unknown
terms.description: The producer could not be determined. Never inferred as agent by default.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: All evidence required by the review profile was collected.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some required evidence is missing or incomplete.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: No evidence could be collected, for example because a sensor could not run.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: The evidence raises a qualified concern short of failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The evidence collected does not establish an outcome.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The aspect does not apply to this subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: The aspect has not yet been reviewed.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: The comparison shows measurable improvement.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: The comparison shows measurable regression.

terms.title: Mixed
terms.description: The comparison shows both improvement and regression.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: The comparison shows no material difference.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: No comparable prior observation exists.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The comparison evidence does not establish a direction.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: The policy permits the subject to proceed.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: The policy flags the subject without blocking it.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: The policy prevents the subject from proceeding.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: The policy defers the decision, for example pending human review.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: The finding has not been dispositioned.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: The finding is accepted as a known risk.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: The finding is waived for a scoped reason.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: The finding does not reflect a real issue.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: The underlying issue was fixed.
